svg.title: Nine-process study M.2, R=3 relative latent trend MSE
svg.desc: Percent excess mean simulated latent-trend MSE above each process row minimum, across 1000 seeds. Lower and lighter are better. This is not a statistical significance chart.
svg.text: 1,000 independent seeds · 11 feasible policies · cell = excess mean MSE over row's minimum (%)
Light = closer to best within this process; dark = larger regret. Differences are NOT necessarily statistically significant.
Source: committed Study M.2 risk_by_process_method.csv · N=80, d=2 · R=3 · method-selected pooled trend MSE
Never compare raw MSE levels across rows to infer ranking; each row normalized separately. No Holm p values encoded.
